top.line: The librarian, my favourite agent, and a library at the heart of the data platform.

in-short.line: A card per item with source, licence, evidence; 78 items; a team; real librarians; the law next.

why.line: Without a library, a pile; with one, a collection and a graph.

holds.line: 78 items with call numbers, browsable by place, topic and date, all as JSON.

team.line: Ontologist, cartographer, graph keeper, historian and reality check; learning from SGraph Send.

librarians.line: An invitation to real librarians; budget to hire them.

next.line: Official sources and the law, so claims about a place can be checked.

limits.line: A day old; no legislation yet; nobody has joined yet.
